Deliberative Poll in Zeguo Township, China, 1) was representative of the Township population, 2) was conducted in an open and transparent manner, 3) was a deliberative process in which the citizens were given a balanced set of briefing materials, 4) had a high quality of deliberation and 5) had an impact on local governance.

1) the DP process was a success in that it was well received by the public, and the participants were satisfied with the process and the outcome; 2) the participants experienced significant knowledge and attitude changes after the event; 3) the DP results were used by the LPC to revise their budgetary preferences; 4) the local government and LPC were satisfied with this process and plan to use the DP again in the near future.
